posts.title: A Practical Introduction to MQTT
posts.excerpt: Why MQTT is the go-to protocol for small-device telemetry, and how we use it in our IoT products.

content.text: What is MQTT?
MQTT is a lightweight publish/subscribe messaging protocol designed for low-bandwidth, high-latency networks. It is the default protocol in most IoT dashboards.
In our **Smart Hub** firmware, MQTT is used to push sensor readings to the cloud with minimal overhead.

content.title: Tip
content.text: Use topic namespaces like sensors/+/temp so dashboards can subscribe to all temperature readings at once.

posts.title: Choosing a Game Engine for Indie Teams
posts.excerpt: Why we use Unity for most titles, and when a custom engine starts to make sense.

content.text: Unity, Godot, or custom?
For small teams, Unity still offers the best balance of asset store, platform support, and documentation.
We reach for custom tooling only when a project has unusual networking or rendering needs.

content.title: Tip
content.text: Start with the engine that gets you to a playable build fastest. Optimise the choice later.

posts.title: LoRaWAN vs Wi-Fi for Sensors
posts.excerpt: When long range and low power beat raw bandwidth.

content.text: Pick the right radio
Wi-Fi is great for devices with power and humans nearby. LoRa wins when devices are far apart, outdoors, and running on batteries.
Our Field Monitor nodes use LoRa to reach a Smart Hub from hundreds of metres away.

content.text: The vibe comes first
Before tuning physics, we tuned the feeling: open road, soft sunset, music that does not demand attention.
Ride Along is a love letter to everyone who drives to clear their head.
